title: In repos/activity-api/src/index.ts, make the exemplar selector's boot run default to enabled so the job can actually exe
description:
In repos/activity-api/src/index.ts, make the exemplar selector's boot run default to enabled so the job can actually execute.

The file contains exactly one occurrence of this fragment, on line 981:
if (process.env.EXEMPLAR_SELECTOR_RUN_ON_BOOT === 'true') {

Replace it with exactly this:
if (process.env.EXEMPLAR_SELECTOR_RUN_ON_BOOT !== 'false') {

One file, one op. The only change is the comparison: === 'true' becomes !== 'false'. Change nothing else on the line, no other line, and no other file. An explicit EXEMPLAR_SELECTOR_RUN_ON_BOOT=false still disables the boot run, so the opt-out is preserved.

WHY. The exemplar selector has never run once, and the execution_exemplar table has 0 rows. Measured on the live substrate today:

- The boot run is the only path that fires promptly, and it is gated on EXEMPLAR_SELECTOR_RUN_ON_BOOT === 'true'. That variable is not set in /etc/substrate/env and is not present in the running process environment, so the gate is closed and the boot run never happens.
- The only other path is setInterval at EXEMPLAR_SELECTOR_INTERVAL_MS, which is also unset and therefore defaults to 24 hours. An in-process interval requires 1440 minutes of continuous uptime to reach its first deadline.
- activity-api started 126 times in the last 24 hours, a mean uptime of 11.4 minutes. Every landed compose restarts vessels, so this is normal operation, not a crash loop: systemd reports NRestarts 0.

A daily in-process timer inside a process whose mean lifetime is 11 minutes can never fire. The interval path is therefore dead by construction, and with the boot gate closed the selector has no live path at all.

The work is real and waiting: trace_digest holds 1244 rows across 88 distinct activity_id groups, which is what the selector iterates. The sweep costs about 13 seconds at the default 150 ms per-activity delay, so running it once per boot is cheap.

This is also why the failure was invisible. The line logging Exemplar selector job started is emitted unconditionally when the interval is registered, so it reports that a schedule was created, never that a run occurred. The logs read healthy while the extraction stage of the learning pipeline produced nothing.
